Title: Official: Legacies of the Blood Promo Cards (spoilers)

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
Posted to http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/?line=news&articleid=296 (the
URL shows the art and full card images - both cards use full-color
versions of the original Kindred Most Wanted portraits by Ken Meyer
Jr):

----------------

Legacies of Blood Promos available now!
Magazine-only promos previewed here.

Genina, The Red Poet
Scrye #89. November 2005.
In stores now.

-----------------------

Genina, the Red Poet
Samedi
Group 3
8 capacity
aus cel for CHI OBF THN
Independent, Red List. If a blood hunt is successfully called on
Genina, she goes to torpor instead of being burned. Genina gets +1
stealth on diablerie actions and on undirected actions.

------------------------

Genina's Discipline spread makes her an interesting vampire. Having
Celerity and Fortitude gives her multi-action options like Freak Drive
and Forced March. She can use these cards to play multiple disruptive
Chimerstry actions. We can expect the multi-rush players to take
advantage of her Disciplines and specials. Her Red List disadvantage
may be a liability, but with cards like Regenerative Blood and Ashes to
Ashes, she'll be hard to put down for good. Genina may prove to be a
destructive force on the table.

Angelo
Game Trade Magazine #69. November 2005.
Available late October.

----------------------------

Angelo
Blood Brother
Group 3
7 capacity
pot vic CEL FOR SAN
Independent, Red List. All Blood Brothers may play cards that require
Sanguinus as if Angelo were a member of any circle. Angelo can burn a
location as a (D) action. He cannot have or use retainers. Sterile.

-----------------------------

First of all, Angelo's special is white hot for any Blood Brothers
deck. The ability to play with either or both current circles makes
Angelo versatile and a necessity in any Blood Brother deck. Angelo's
Disciplines lend to the "beats" side of deckbuilding with Potence,
Celerity, Vicissitude, and Fortitude. Additionally, his superior
Celerity and Fortitude let him act at +1 stealth with Forced March, an
ability the Blood Brothers had been lacking.

---------------------------

-John Flournoy
-posting this since Oscar's too lazy to - I mean, since he asked :P

Exactly--both the vampires presented are very utilitarian. As Group 3,
they'll pretty much go in any deck for the given clan, and the BB guy is
even *more* utilitarian, given how his clan works. With this particular
distribution scheme, they'll be more difficult to get than many other promos

certainly possible that they'll become the new Marcus Vitel. But on initial
inspection, it seems kinda dubious.

desirable.

Barbaro is pretty corner case useful, but not generally useful (like most
other promos tend to be). These two seem like they'll be basic crypt
building units.

Past behaviour: They've gone along with it, pretty much.
